body:
During 1964 at Fort Detrick, MD (as well as other places) several soldiers volunteered for testing with the bizarre drug; BZ. I was one who underwent the experience at Ft. Detrick. BZ was almost like a cross between Ketamine/PCP and LSD (not actually but that is what it felt like). The US ARMY/CIA tested this drug on a few thousand soldiers, and civilians. There exists plenty of film footage of this which has been aired on television many years ago. The effects were interesting to myself but absolutely frightening to others. Look up old articles from the 70's from the Christian Science Monitor. BZ is way-out, dissassociated, and very bizarre. Long term effects, yes, it turned me into a Psychedelic Ranger.
